newsitem.title: CHINA: China chef who killed novelist sentenced to death.
newsitem.headline: China chef who killed novelist sentenced to death.

text.p: A Shanghai court on Friday sentenced a former chef to death for murdering a famous Chinese novelist and her niece and robbing them of money and valuables, the Xinhua news agency said.
Tao Feng had confessed during his trial to killing Dai Houying and her niece, Dai Hui, on August 25 at the novelist's Shanghai home, the official agency said.
The 27-year-old former chef had the right to appeal against the sentence, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
Tao was the grandson of one of Dai Houying's middle school teachers and first met the novelist last April through a letter of introduction from his grandmother, the agency said.
Chinese newspapers have said a special team of more than 100 police were assigned to the case.
Last month they tracked Tao down to hotel in central Anhui province where he was found with Dai Houying's bank account book.
